column1: # Brand-name test for the synthetic fixtures in this folder (see README.md).
# Each expected site matches the query at least as well as any look-alike
# and has far stronger popularity signals, so any sensible ranker that blends
# name matching with popularity should get them all. Some names are only
# findable through link text or aliases (bofa, amex, nyt, citibank), and some
# real sites share a name (chase / chase center, delta / delta faucet,
# ford / ford foundation, amazon / amazon jobs).
